lines.en: I walk on two legs with a long stride.

lines.zh: 我瘦高的身子在树间穿行
lines.en: My tall thin frame moves between trees.

lines.zh: 我的影子细得像一根杆
lines.en: My shadow is thin as a pole.
Each step rocks my shoulders.
My arms hang past my knees.
Head low, eyes still watching.
Twigs snap under my feet.
I don't go around. I push through.
My breath rasps across the bark.
The hide on me is pulled tight.
I pause and sniff the wind.

lines.zh: 风从左边来，我偏了偏头
lines.en: Wind from the left; I tilt my head.
I stand with one shoulder high.
My fingers are too long and bent.
I'm listening to the woods.

lines.zh: 两副骨头挤在一具身体里
lines.en: Two skeletons crammed into one body.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸里有两种声音
lines.en: Two sounds in my breathing.
I turn my head slowly aside.

lines.zh: 这具身体很难安静下来
lines.en: This body finds it hard to be still.
My eyes aren't quite alike.
I scratch my own arm.
I wait for things to walk in. I don't chase.

lines.zh: 我侧过头，用两只眼看你
lines.en: I turn and fix you with both eyes.
You're a head shorter than I thought.

lines.zh: 我的肩在动，不是我在动
lines.en: My shoulder moves. Not me.
You can see me. Good.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，你退了半步
lines.en: I take half a step; you give half.
This body likes you.
Both of us are watching.
Don't try to work out what I am.
You humans are always this small.

lines.zh: 我把头歪成一个不对的角度
lines.en: I tilt my head to a wrong angle.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，两个声音都乱了
lines.en: I sway and both voices tangle.
A bone has slipped out of place.
I give half a step and straighten.
There's little blood in the wound.
This body takes hits well.

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在听伤口说话。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if listening to the wound.
My breathing grows coarser.

lines.zh: 你打中了两副骨头的接缝
lines.en: You hit the seam between the two.

lines.zh: 疼传到我这儿，已经很远了。
lines.en: The pain reaches me from far away.
I put a hand over it.

lines.zh: 你举着的那个不够我吃
lines.en: That won't feed me.
I have more than one stomach.
Come closer and let me smell.
You back away faster than you offer.
That smells like dirt.
I'm not fussy, but I eat a great deal.
Set it down and walk off.
I'll come slowly. Don't run.
Food is small. You're the larger matter.
Higher. I can't see it.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一捆骨头
lines.en: You hit me like a bundle of bones.
I don't give ground. I just tilt.
My arm comes between us.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我两个声音都停了
lines.en: That stopped both my voices.
I'm too tall. You can't reach.
You duck under my ribs.
I turn slowly; I can't get round.
Don't press against my ribs.
We collide, loudly.
Hit me again and I'll grab you.
This body has no need of a mate.
Two skeletons is already crowded.

lines.zh: 这种事，我这副身子不懂。
lines.en: This body of mine knows nothing of such things.
You may stay, if you want.
But don't come that close.
At night I stand without moving.
You can sleep under that tree.
I don't sleep. I watch.

lines.zh: 有人陪，这身体会安静些
lines.en: With company, this body quiets a little.
Only a very little.
I bend and my spine rattles.
My fingers are too long to pinch.
I pick it up to look.

lines.zh: 两百点生命，刷怪蛋才叫得动我。
lines.en: Two hundred health; only a spawn egg calls me.
You dropped it; I stepped on half.
I tuck it between my ribs to carry.

lines.zh: 这具身体会自己决定要不要
lines.en: This body decides whether it wants it.
I hold on to it. No plan to return it.
Useless, so I drop it.
Useful, so I keep it.
You've come into my range.
My head turns to you and stops.
This body moved first.
I come at you, not fast.
My long arm reaches out first.
The tree won't save you.
I don't roar. I don't need to.
Both of us have you now.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，这一下会很重。
lines.en: I raise my arm — this will land heavy.
You have one step left to take.
Another and you're against the tree.
Right then. Here.
Both my arms have come up.
Don't shut your eyes on me.
Watch closely. Don't blink.
Two heads, one idea.
Step by step, soles on the ground.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的长腿也换。
lines.en: You change course; my long legs change too.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你圈在里面
lines.en: My shadow has you circled.
Your hands are still raised.
I'm gauging your strength.
A little short on strength.
You've gone behind the stone.
That stone is low.
I only need to walk around it.
Your breathing is climbing.
My heartbeat is slow.
This body isn't in a hurry.
I am all four sides of this wood.
I could walk this wood blind.
Two steps of distance left.
This arm is coming up.

lines.zh: 你回头的那一瞬，就是现在。
lines.en: The instant you look back — now.
I'm not waiting any longer.
I've got you fixed now.
Stand still, not one move.

lines.zh: 我的长手臂扫过你的胸口
lines.en: My long arm sweeps your chest.

lines.zh: 这一抓落在你的护肩上
lines.en: This grab lands on your pauldron.
The shove slams you into a trunk.

lines.zh: 我的力气不止一副骨头
lines.en: My strength is more than one skeleton's.

lines.zh: 你挡住一下，第二下到了
lines.en: You block one; the second arrives.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的衣领
lines.en: My fingers hook your collar.

lines.zh: 整个身子的重量都压下去。
lines.en: All my weight comes down with it.
My grip leaves a dent in your armour.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，踩住你的影子
lines.en: I lift a foot onto your shadow.
You retreat; I follow.

lines.zh: 我这副瘦高身子，两百点血。
lines.en: This lanky frame carries two hundred health.
You can't take this blow.
You're still standing. Good.
Still up? Then again.
Both my hands come at once.
You're at the treeline now.
Past that is open ground.
Even less cover there.
This grab goes for your throat.
That one finished it.

lines.zh: 我从不自然里来，是被叫来的
lines.en: I don't come naturally. I was called.
Every bird in the wood has flown.
I stand taller than the saplings.

lines.zh: 我的两个声音同时开口
lines.en: Both my voices speak at once.

lines.zh: 空气里有股旧骨头的味
lines.en: There's a smell of old bone in the air.
I twist my neck. It cracks.
This body was only just assembled.
I look down at my own fingers.
The number of fingers is wrong.
I don't care in the slightest.
Something is close.
I turn my head that way.
The hide shrinks in the fire.
I land and one leg folds under me.
Water fills both my throats.
The blast tips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我两根肋骨之间
lines.en: An arrow jams between two of my ribs.

lines.zh: 这光让两副骨头都在响
lines.en: That light sets both skeletons rattling.
Both my stomachs are crying out.

lines.zh: 雷穿过我，两副骨头一起颤
lines.en: Lightning runs through me and both frames shake.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，两个声音都在喊
lines.en: I fall, both voices crying out.
